0.original: Hien is ready to become a warrior of the Steppe.

48.original: <yawn> That was just what I needed!

49.original: A new beginning lies beyond the horizon. We have but to seize it with our own two hands.

50.original: Was the food to your liking? Good, good...

51.original: Now then, Cirina, if you would tell us of the trial we must undertake that we might participate in the Naadam.

52.original: Ah, yes! As I mentioned before, to be recognized as warriors of the Steppe, one must follow in the footsteps of the legendary warrior Bardam.

53.original: He embarked on a great pilgrimage, eschewing cart and horse, and walked for many malms until he came to a holy place, thereafter named Bardam's Mettle. There, at the altar, as he did, you must pray.

54.original: The altar lies deep within the breeding grounds of the yol. To complete your trial, you must tame one. Only then will your trial be complete.

55.original: Fair enough. And where is the entrance to Bardam's Mettle?

56.original: You must journey far, far to the west─beyond Chakha Zoh, where lie the bones of a great and wise woman.

57.original: Beyond the ruins of Ceol Aen, hidden within the mountains is a narrow pass. Follow it, and you will come to Bardam's Mettle.

58.original: Sounds to me like it'll be a trial just getting to the trial...

59.original: More than you may know. On the eve of the Naadam, many strive to improve their fortunes─some by abducting and enslaving the warriors of other tribes.

60.original: Be ever mindful of your surroundings, lest you be taken as well.

61.original: Hah! What grim expressions you wear while nodding so powerfully! Warriors such as you are not like to fall en route to a mere rite of passage.

62.original: We shall proceed with all due caution, yes, but let us not worry overmuch.

63.original: We will overcome this trial, and the next, and the next, until we stand triumphant. That is all there is to it, no?

64.original: With me, my friends! To the west! To Bardam's Mettle!

65.original: W-Wait, Hien! Oh dear. I knew I would forget.

66.original: Here─take these whistles. Once tamed, your yol will hearken to their call.

67.original: Thanks. We'll try them out once we've finished the trial.

68.original: Let's catch up to Hien and Gosetsu!

69.original: It is indeed a perilous journey, but I know you will succeed─as I once did.

70.original: We still have a long way to go, but I think I can see that monument Cirina talked about.

71.original: I don't see Hien or Gosetsu, though. We should hurry!

72.original: Hey...I don't know about you, but I can't shake the feeling someone's watching us.

73.original: Cirina did warn us about tribes that kidnap warriors and make them fight for them. Something tells me we're about to meet them...

75.original: Your blood shall water the soil.

76.original: They're wearing yellow. I've seen their clothes somewhere before...

77.original: Is that the best you can do!? Come, villains! Come at me!

78.original: Ah, there you are. As you can see, they left us little choice.

79.original: I gather you were forced to dispatch a few yourself? So it goes. A few less warriors to face in the Naadam, eh?

80.original: Ceol Aen is not much further. That said, I should be surprised if our would-be masters do not try to subdue us one final time...

82.original: <huff> <puff> This is it! The real trial!

83.original: Tread softly. We are for hallowed ground, and the kami are restless...

84.original: Right. This must be the pass that leads to Bardam's Mettle.

85.original: They say no foreigners have overcome this trial, but, well, there is a first time for everything, no?

86.original: Perhaps you do not hail from these lands, but your forefathers did. You do them honor to carry on their legacy this day.
